LESSON: READING ALOUD: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.2 Reading aloud (2 sessions) • Syllables blending • Simple words By th
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud: Fluency, part of Reading 2.2 Reading aloud (2 sessions) • Syllables blending • Simple words By th in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How can one improve their reading skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. read words relating to days of the week accurately,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. relate activities to days of the week for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. develop interest in reading Arabic texts for pleasure.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud: Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. read words relating to days of the week accurately,

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. relate activities to days of the week for comprehension,

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. develop interest in reading Arabic texts for pleasure.

   Reading Aloud: Fluency helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. engage in reading words on days of the week accurately,

2. listen to audio recordings of days of the week read at different paces and repeat,

3. work jointly to match activities to specific days they take place,

4. list the days of the week on flashcards and display in class,

5. work collaboratively to engage in a reading contest for fluency and effective communication.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. engage in reading words on days of the week accurately,
2. listen to audio recordings of days of the week read at different paces and repeat,
3. work jointly to match activities to specific days they take place,
4. list the days of the week on flashcards and display in class,
5. work collaboratively to engage in a reading contest for fluency and effective communication.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud: Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: This is developed as the learner interacts with audio recordings of days of the week read at different paces

and repeats.

• Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner builds on the reading prowess when working

collaboratively to engage in a reading contest for fluency and effective communication.

28

Values:
Love: This is nurtured as the learner ensures care and regard for others when giving each other adequate time to match activities

to specific days they take place.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Nationalism: This is promoted as the learner engages with peers equally and respectfully to work on improving their reading

fluency.

Links to other Learning Areas:
